content:
I’m an 18-year-old CS student currently in my 3rd semester, and I've been diving deep into full-stack development. I wanted to share a weekend project, and I would love to get your technical feedback on it!

Why I Built It

I wanted a way for anyone to evaluate a developer's GitHub profile in a couple of seconds, get useful insights, and instantly generate a highly visual "stats card" that they can post publicly on their social media.

check out here: https://github-dashboard-ak69.vercel.app/

Let me know your thoughts
